title: Locally-averaged McCormick relaxations for discretization-regularized inverse problems
summary: In this paper, by means of a standard model problem, we devise an approach to computing approximate dual bounds for use in global optimization of coefficient identification in partial differential equations (PDEs) by, e.g., (spatial) branch-and-bound methods. Linearization is achieved by a McCormick relaxation (that is, replacing the bilinear PDE term by a linear one and adding inequality constraints), combined with local averaging to reduce the number of inequalities.
